# agent-desktop 1.3.0 + Windows patches (xingbao-v1.3.0-patched.1)

This release is a **modified fork** of [vercel-labs/agent-desktop](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop) v1.3.0,
built for Windows. It contains the upstream v1.3.0 source plus three patches:

| Commit | Patch |
|---|---|
| `51dba69` | Cherry-pick of upstream PR [#651](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop/pull/651): recover foreground activation through UI Automation |
| `aab1c4d` | Tolerate UWP HWND ownership changes during window show verbs (D-05) |
| `ad4e3eb` | Synthesize a physical wheel for `--headed` scroll when no ScrollPattern exists (D-03 headed) |

## Why

Upstream v1.3.0 has Windows defects that block real desktop use:

- Electron/UWP windows fail `focus-window` with `did not become foreground`;
- UWP `minimize` reports `WINDOW_NOT_FOUND` after the HWND migrates to `ApplicationFrameHost`;
- headed clicks on some controls appeared occluded when the target was not foreground;
- `scroll` on Notepad text / Chromium documents returns `axis_not_scrollable`.

## Verified behavior (Windows 10.0.26200 x64)

- D-02: `focus-window` on Electron and UWP Calculator returns `ok:true, is_focused:true`.
- D-05: UWP `minimize` / `restore` return `delivered_verified`.
- D-01: headed click on a Notepad button returns `ok:true` (foreground fix removes the false occlusion).
- D-03: `scroll --headed` on Notepad text / Chromium document returns `ok:true` via `SendInput.wheel`; **headless scroll remains fail-closed by design**.
- Protocol remains **2.6**; `/api/desktop/status` reports protocol 1.3.0 and all checks green.
- Regression: `desktop:check`, `test:desktop:win` 12 PASS, repo tests 65 pass, Agent E2E focus/minimize/restore 3/3.

## Known limitations

- This build is **unsigned**; Windows SmartScreen may warn.
- Text controls still do not support `click` (use `set-value` / typing).
- `scroll` without `--headed` still fails on targets without ScrollPattern.
- The three patches are carried in this fork; they are not in upstream v1.3.0. Rebase policy: track upstream `main` and re-apply the patch series.
